output.reason: The computed diff between the v2.6.4 and v2.7.0 install bundles [ev-782bc47d120d] [ev-c2c6c790d6b2] reads "removed [], added [\"ExternalArtifact\"]". That means no allowed value was removed. It does not mean an empty-string value was removed. The proposed exposure, HelmRelease resources whose spec.chartRef.kind equals "", comes from misreading that empty list.
